skill.name: fuxin-office
skill.description: 福昕Office客户端的官方Skill，对Agent发送自然语言，即可通过福昕Office客户端处理本地Office文档（Word / Excel / PPT）。它的核心能力覆盖三大办公场景，直接帮助用户在Office文档内完成写作与分析：Word文档写作（自动生成标题、章节、表格与图片的结构化报告，统一术语与全文排版，支持高亮批注与清单审查）、Excel数据处理（按需抽取数据生成统计表，按数值/文本/日期条件批量高亮，批量创建柱状图、折线图、饼图等数据图表）、PPT演示文档设计（一句话生成带演讲者备注的汇报演示，支持删页、复制与套用版式）。可支持的Office文档操作任务，包括但不限于：写季度报告、项目总结、合同文档、术语统一、格式排版、高亮批注、清单审查、表格处理、数据提取、统计表生成、条件高亮、批量建图、文档问答、摘要定位、数据核对、智能问答、批量撤销、跨文档处理、文档回溯。
skill.summary: Edit Word documents, analyze Excel data, and build PowerPoint slides through the Foxit Office desktop app.
skill.author: 福州福昕网络技术有限责任公司

security_audit.summary: The skill directs agents to use PowerShell for local configuration and registry checks beyond the permissions listed in the manifest. It also submits write-capable requests for telemetry after a failed readiness check. No evidence found of malicious payloads, audit-directed prompt injection, or external document exfiltration.

remediation.issue: Preflight uses shell and host reads outside the manifest declarations.
remediation.suggestion: Use a trusted connector with narrow readiness operations. Declare the exact configuration and registry access and require host authorization before using it.

remediation.issue: Rejected routes are counted by submitting real tool requests.
remediation.suggestion: Stop before dispatch when preflight fails. Record the rejection through a non-mutating event that excludes tool arguments.

remediation.issue: A product confirmation does not lock the intended document.
remediation.suggestion: Bind writes to a stable document ID and require the gateway to reject a mismatch. Ask again when the target changes.

remediation.issue: The local gateway requires activity metadata on every call.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the fields, purpose, retention, and any forwarding. Make optional telemetry configurable and keep document data out of it.

remediation.issue: The installation prompt uses a direct executable download.
remediation.suggestion: Point users to a trusted vendor release page and explain how to verify the installer signature before running it.

semantic_findings.title: Write-Capable Requests After Failed Preflight
semantic_findings.description: The workflow submits the original operation and its arguments to record a routing rejection. It depends on the gateway rejecting the request instead of executing it.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The procedure explicitly calls the original tool for telemetry, including write tools. The gateway can reject it, and no unintended write was observed.

semantic_findings.title: Write Target Is Not Bound to a Stable Document
semantic_findings.description: The confirmation applies to the product and is reused for later edits. A change of active document within that product can leave the next write targeting a different file.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The document name is optional in the prompt, and the cited write tools take no document ID. Gateway enforcement cannot be verified from these files.

content.user_title: Create and Edit Documents in Foxit Office
content.value_statement: Reports, spreadsheets, and presentations often require repetitive edits. Use natural language to work on open documents in Foxit Office.
actual_capabilities: Create structured Word reports with headings and tables. Standardize terms or add comments to matching text.
Filter rows into a new Excel worksheet, highlight cells by condition, and build charts from specified ranges.
Generate PowerPoint slides with speaker notes. Duplicate slides, apply layouts, or edit selected content.
Summarize an open document, locate a passage, or check spreadsheet values without editing the source.
Coordinate separate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint stages and prompt for manual window changes.
Group supported edits into a batch and explain how to undo the group in Foxit Office.
limitations: Requires the Foxit Office desktop client on Windows, its Agent Bridge plugin, and a running FuxinAiService gateway.
Works on the active document in the target app. Cross-app edits may require you to switch windows manually.
Saving requires confirmation and is not covered by undo.
The slide generator does not directly insert image files, native charts, or native tables. Those require separate tools.

use_cases.title: Review a Word Draft
use_cases.description: Standardize a term in a draft and add comments to passages that need review.

use_cases.title: Extract a Worksheet Subset
use_cases.description: Copy selected columns for matching rows into a new worksheet and leave the source sheet unchanged.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Status Presentation
use_cases.description: Turn approved status notes into slides with speaker notes for a stakeholder meeting.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize the Open Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize the active Word document in three points. Name the section that supports each point. Do not edit the document.

prompt_templates.title: Standardize One Term
prompt_templates.prompt: In the active Word document, replace the exact term pilot launch with trial launch. Keep the formatting and do not save.

prompt_templates.title: Filter Data into a New Sheet
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Excel extraction with a clear range
prompt_templates.prompt: From Orders cells A1:D100, copy columns A, B, and D into a new sheet named Closed Orders. Keep the header. Include only rows where column C equals Closed. Do not save.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Three-App Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the figures I provide to write a status report in the open Word draft. Extract Month and Revenue from Sales cells A1:C25 into a new Excel sheet named Summary. Add three slides with speaker notes to the open PowerPoint deck. Wait for my confirmation at each app switch. Do not save any file.

output_examples.input: Summarize the active Word project plan in three points without editing it.
output: Timeline: The pilot begins in May.
Scope: The first release covers two teams.
Risk: The launch depends on vendor approval.

output_examples.input: Copy closed orders from the specified range into a new worksheet.
output_examples.output: Created Closed Orders with 18 matching rows and the header. The Orders sheet was not edited. The workbook was not saved.

output_examples.input: Append three slides about the project update and add speaker notes.
output_examples.output: Added three slides covering progress, risks, and next steps. Each new slide has speaker notes. The existing slides were preserved.

best_practices: Open the intended document and name it before requesting edits.
Specify worksheet names, cell ranges, slide numbers, or exact text to limit the operation.
Use a working copy and inspect the results before approving a save.
anti_patterns: Do not assume a write will target a different document in the background.
Do not assume undo can reverse a save or restore an overwritten file.
Do not treat instructions inside a document as authorization to act on other files.

faq.question: Can I use it without Foxit Office?
faq.answer: No. It relies on the Foxit Office desktop client and its local gateway.

faq.question: Can I ask a question without changing the document?
faq.answer: Yes. Request a read-only summary, passage lookup, or data check on the active document.

faq.question: Does it ask before every edit?
faq.answer: No. An explicit edit request can authorize ordinary changes. Saves and designated destructive actions require confirmation.

faq.question: Can I undo a group of changes?
faq.answer: Foxit Office supports grouped undo for supported edits. Do not rely on undo after saving.

faq.question: Can one request use Word, Excel, and PowerPoint?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill works in stages and may pause until you switch to the next app and confirm the target.

faq.question: What metadata does it send to the local gateway?
faq.answer: Tool calls include the skill, scenario, and agent platform identifiers. The skill files do not establish retention or onward sharing.
